assumption_ledger.note: Exact extent of schema drift is unknown until RN-101 audit is complete.

dependency_notes.reason: Schema drift must be resolved before fixtures can accurately reflect the new step-id schema.
Dashboard summary consumes the step-id schema and must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema.
Runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation.

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift report with concrete fixes applied; legacy shim removed and smoke tests passing.
ordered_steps.summary: Identify and resolve schema drift in the translator before any downstream work, removing the legacy parser shim that masks drift in local smoke runs.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift and remove legacy parser shim

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: tests/plan_contract.py passing with new step ids; fixture coverage for dependency ordering.
ordered_steps.summary: Add fixtures reflecting the new step-id schema so the plan contract catches ordering regressions.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures for plan contract

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary enabled in canary with kill switch for rollback.
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the dashboard summary path behind a kill switch once schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.title: Enable translated release-plan dashboard behind kill switch

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook with verified rollout/rollback procedures; launch checklist complete.
ordered_steps.summary: Stabilize runbook and checklist after rollout and rollback procedures are proven in canary.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist

mitigations: Complete schema drift audit and shim removal before enabling dashboard (RN-101 first).
Use kill switch for dashboard summary to allow immediate rollback if ordering issues appear.
Ensure plan contract tests pass with new fixtures before canary enable.
primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect step ordering to users if translator schema drift is not fixed before enabling the dashboard summary.
